in_telugu.long_meaning: దేశిక, దేశికత్వ (enlightened being, being of power)

in_marathi.name: Bodhisattva
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Awake being, enlightened being
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bodhisattva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Buddhism, a Bodhisattva is an enlightened being who has achieved a deep understanding of the nature of reality but has not yet entered Nirvana. They choose to remain in the cycle of rebirth to help others attain enlightenment. In Hinduism, a Bodhisattva is a being on the path to enlightenment, often depicted as a deity who grants boons and protects the faithful.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Bodhisattva একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Buddhism, a Bodhisattva is an enlightened being who has achieved a deep understanding of the nature of reality but has not yet entered Nirvana. They choose to remain in the cycle of rebirth to help others attain enlightenment. In Hinduism, a Bodhisattva is a being on the path to enlightenment, often depicted as a deity who grants boons and protects the faithful.
